items.title: AMD 将以 82 亿美元收购李飞飞创办的 World Labs
items.title_zh: AMD 以 82 亿美元收购李飞飞创办的 World Labs
items.title_en: AMD to Acquire Fei-Fei Li's World Labs for $8.2B
items.summary: AMD announced it will acquire Fei-Fei Li's world-model startup World Labs for $8.2 billion, with Li joining AMD as Executive Vice President and Chief Scientist pending regulatory approval.

items.title: GPT 6.1 Sol: Near-Astra intelligence for a fifth of the price
items.title_zh: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6.1 Sol：智能接近 Astra，价格仅为其五分之一
items.title_en: OpenAI launches GPT-6.1 Sol with near-Astra intelligence at one-fifth the price
items.summary: OpenAI announces GPT-6.1 Sol, claiming near-Astra intelligence at one-fifth the price, sparking HN debate over pricing, model quality, and naming.

items.title: America.gov
items.title_zh: America.gov 上线，借助 Google Gemini 帮民众办理公共服务
items.title_en: America.gov launches with Google Gemini to guide citizens through public services
items.summary: America.gov is a new US government website using Google Gemini to help citizens navigate and access public services, sparking discussion on its usefulness and implementation.

items.title: A Privacy Analysis of Web and Mobile Conversational AI Agents [pdf]
items.title_zh: 关于网页与移动端对话式 AI 智能体的隐私分析
items.title_en: Privacy Analysis of Web and Mobile Conversational AI Agents
items.summary: The paper analyzes privacy risks in web and mobile conversational AI agents, sparking HN discussion on silent prompt pre-sending, weak UUID-based privacy, and training data exposure.

items.title: Quoting Anthropic Frontier Red Team
items.title_zh: Anthropic：GLM-5.3 与 Claude Mythos 跨越网络攻击能力门槛
items.title_en: Anthropic: GLM-5.3 and Claude Mythos Cross Cyber Exploit Threshold
items.summary: Anthropic reports that newer AI models like GLM-5.3 and Claude Mythos Preview can achieve full control flow hijacks in binary exploitation tasks, marking a threshold in advanced cyber capabilities compared to earlier models.

items.title: 🤖 OpenAI 开发者大会推出 dots 智能体等 20 余项更新
items.title_zh: OpenAI 2026 开发者大会：常驻智能体 Dots 与 20 余项更新
items.title_en: OpenAI DevDay 2026: Dots always-on agents and 20+ updates
items.summary: OpenAI's developer conference introduced 20+ updates including the always-on Dots agent, GPT-6.1 Sol and Astra Ultrafast models, new developer APIs, and a higher-tier Pro 500 subscription.
